detail.longDescription: Guess what? In spite of all the hard sell to the contrary, this research found that most young men in the US want what we all do - to be able to earn a living wage while having time to care for ourselves & chosen family. Rejecting the absurdity of gendered caricatures, we can aspire to living as a Whole Human Being. Who’d of thunk it. Whose interests are served by deflecting attention away from increasing inequality & costs of living, by seeking to polarise communities around issues of gender expression? 🤔 # gender # research # polarisation # distraction # plunder # WeSeeYou https://www. theguardian.com/commentisfree/ 2026/nov/13/young-men-us-midterms-democrats?CMP=Share_iOSApp_Other
